name: @pipeworx/mcp-hex-pm

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Look up a single Hex.pm package (Elixir/Erlang mix package) by name. Returns description, licenses, links, latest version, and download counts.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search the Hex.pm registry for Elixir/Erlang mix packages by keyword. Returns a list of matching packages with descriptions, latest versions, and downloads.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Get details for a specific version (release) of a Hex.pm package (Elixir/Erlang mix package): dependency requirements, docs availability, publisher, and downloads.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List all published versions (releases) of a Hex.pm package (Elixir/Erlang mix package), each with its version and publish date.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hex-pm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hex-pm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
